record.one_liner: Brex offers a REST API for financial data and card management using bearer token authentication generated from the Brex dashboard.

auth_methods.quote: To pass your user token to Brex APIs, add it as a header to your API calls in the following format: Authorization: "Bearer {{your user_token here}}"

access_test.quote: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin . Go to Developer > Settings . If your company has not accepted the developer API agreement, please review the terms and conditions.

access_ship.quote: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin . Go to Developer > Settings . If your company has not accepted the developer API agreement, please review the terms and conditions.

api_type.quote: Brex currently only offers a production API server at https://api.brex.com . This is the base URL for all API calls.
